lyrics:
[intro]
[verse]
The moonlight hits the pavement floor
I'm walking through the velvet door
Everyone hides behind a face
Lost in a cold and hollow place
But I am holding all the keys
Doing whatever I shall please
Silver stars beneath my feet
Rhythm rising in the street
[chorus]
Change the mask and change the rule
Dancing like I own the cool
Change the mask and change the rule
Nobody plays me for a fool
[verse]
Witching hour starts to chime
Frozen in this electric time
No one here can tell my name
Playing my own wicked game
Turning shadows into light
Taking over all the night
[chorus]
Change the mask and change the rule
Dancing like I own the cool
Change the mask and change the rule
Nobody plays me for a fool
[bridge]
Who is hiding in the dark
Waiting for the magic spark
I decide where we begin
Let the midnight party spin
Strip the velvet from the skin
Let the real fun just begin
No rules bound to hold me now
Making every spirit bow
[outro]
